turns.speaker: [PERSON_5]
turns.text: [PERSON_1], [PERSON_2], forwarding this before the weekend. [PERSON_3] replied to my recap this afternoon, [PERSON_4] piled on w/ the marchex numbers. tanya's bit about the google ads lag is pasted below, that's the thing i keep hearing from the bdc. renewal is dec 1 & they're already shopping. pasting the bit from the recording:

turns.speaker: [PERSON_5]
turns.text: [PERSON_6]: it's not that they don't show up um, they they show up it's the timing the appointment conversions still aren't in google until two days later so by the time the bidding reacts the week's already half gone [PERSON_5]: two days from the call or two days from when the bdc marks the appointment? [PERSON_6]: from the call near as i can tell we set the appointment same day sometimes same hour i don't have a clean way to prove it that's just what i see when i pull the two reports side by side [PERSON_5]: okay. let me get the specifics from you offline, dates and and a couple of call ids, and i'll take it to our team

turns.speaker: [PERSON_4]
turns.text: Adding the numbers so we're all looking at the same thing.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_4]
turns.text: Marchex's per-rooftop number is roughly 30% below what we pay you today, and it includes call scoring. That's their opening quote, not a negotiated one, so I'd expect it to move if we push. I ran it across the 22 rooftops in AZ and NV and it's a real gap, not a rounding error.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_4]
turns.text: To be fair to [PERSON_5]'s team, the platform does what we bought it for. [PERSON_6]'s the one living with the delay on the appointment conversions, so I'll let her speak to that.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_4]
turns.text: [PERSON_4]

turns.speaker: [PERSON_4]
turns.text: [PERSON_4] VP, Marketing Atlas Auto Group [EMAIL_1]

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: [PERSON_5],

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Thanks for the recap. I'll be direct with you because I think it saves us both time.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: We are not in a position to renew on the current terms, and we have asked Marchex for a formal proposal. Finance flagged this before the summer and the number has only gotten harder to defend as we've added rooftops. I'd rather you hear it from me now than in November.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: That doesn't mean we're walking. [PERSON_4]'s team uses the platform every day and [PERSON_6] would tell you the same. But the terms have to make sense against what else is out there.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: [PERSON_3]

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: [PERSON_3] Group Controller Atlas Auto Group [EMAIL_2]

turns.speaker: [PERSON_5]
turns.text: [PERSON_3], [PERSON_4], [PERSON_6],

turns.speaker: [PERSON_5]
turns.text: Thanks for the time on Wednesday. Wanted to put the main points in writing so we're aligned.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_5]
turns.text: We walked through how the tracking numbers are set up across the rooftops and how the Google Ads and Meta conversions are flowing. [PERSON_6]'s team raised the timing on the appointment conversions landing in Google, and I've asked our team to look at that.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_5]
turns.text: [PERSON_3], you mentioned finance wants to see the renewal terms earlier this cycle given the December 2026 date. I'll work with [PERSON_1] on our side and come back to you.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_5]
turns.text: Anything I missed, just reply and I'll fold it in.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_5]
turns.text: [PERSON_5]

turns.speaker: [PERSON_5]
turns.text: [PERSON_5] Customer Success Manager Invoca [EMAIL_3]
